term: passive appetitive power in the account of the soul
definition: The q.80 account calls appetite a passive power naturally apt to be moved by an apprehended object, with the power proportioned to its mover. This contextual creaturely account is not a definition of the old primitive HasWill for every being or a claim that God has unrealized potency.
